scope: Six local stages: metadata connection/recovery identity; captured websocket auth; attestation fixture pump; Bedrock routing/SDK credential availability; Bedrock boundary fixtures; qualification receipt

mechanical_findings.description: New call passes positional None for expected_message without the exact AGENTS argument comment.

verified_source_properties: Connection compatibility omits only Prewarm request-kind and root-turn correlation; durable recovery projection and per-request metadata retain them.
Other compatibility fields, provider/base URL/query/provider headers/beta features, auth credentials/accounts/tasks and custom security headers still distinguish reuse.

Authentication is captured once; those exact headers form the comparison binding and are applied to the actual upgrade. AgentAssertion stable identity includes immutable signing record and task; debug redacts binding.
100 ms production attestation timeout, failure envelope, connection/header limits and header merge order were not changed.
Attestation test now pumps requests while awaiting turn/start and turn/completed; it still checks nonzero attestation requests, one handshake and the exact header.
Bedrock remains experimental and account-auth serialized. Workload identity, external ChatGPT auth and forced ChatGPT denial precede credential resolution.

SDK credential availability is resolved before configuration write; it is explicitly not AWS service authorization. Discovery returns profile/region/credential-type availability rather than credential values.
Only editable active user command-auth is cleared; command-auth from any other layer is rejected before config or credential writes.
Config transaction still restricts writes to the active user file and preserves requirements/semantic validation.
New denial fixtures isolate SDK credential sources and assert unchanged config/auth.json/.env; mock container SDK success/failure exercises the fallback.
validation_performed_here: Read all production diffs and relevant call sites/tests
git diff --check over exact six-stage range: PASS
remaining_boundaries: Exact native core/model-provider/app-server integration validation remains pending, as stated by the handoff; isolated module tests are not owning integration evidence.
AWS credential resolution does not validate ListModels/service authorization; the existing explicit TODO remains.
Independent Windows outside-DELETE blocker remains open and is unrelated to this batch.
Cold-resume active-permission re-resolution and remote catalog TTL failures are outside this batch's closure claims.
